shots.content: Inside a living room, a sofa and armchairs surround a low coffee table between a bookcase and the doorway. A woman in an emerald cardigan at the bookcase-side sofa seat asks a question, while a man in a mustard hoodie sits at the doorway-side sofa seat and a woman in a navy blazer sits at the bookcase-side armchair.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway side, looking across the coffee table toward the bookcase, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair in frame.

shots.content: The woman in an emerald cardigan at the bookcase-side sofa seat swaps seats with the man in a mustard hoodie at the doorway-side sofa seat, who answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the coffee-table side, centered on the two adjacent sofa seats.

shots.content: The woman in a navy blazer replies.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the bookcase side, looking across the coffee table toward the doorway, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair in frame.
